title: Dev Opportunity Radar #19: Hacktoberfest, $20K AI Agent Hackathon, and Pear Prime 2027
why_read: A roundup of hackathons, programs, and opportunities rather than technical content itself.
analysis: This is a recurring newsletter-style post aggregating opportunities like hackathons, fellowships, and community events, with brief mentions of resources like 'How to Scale Your Model.'
